### Added

- (agent-platform) [Check before editing or deleting whether agent-manager can open the pull request](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3261) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Editing or deleting an agent applied from Git tells you up front when the portal cannot open a pull request for it, and where to change it instead, or asks you to authorize GitHub first when that is all that's missing.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Name an agent's organization beside its name in the Agents list](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3265) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — In Customize's Agents list, an agent's `Organization: <name>` sits next to its name instead of in a column of its own, so rows of different organizations line up again.
- (agent-platform) [Give the egress refusal's real remedy, hide refused egress on coding Harnesses](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3262) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — A session's `Outgoing connection to <host> blocked` says what you can actually do, depending on the agent's runtime and your rights. On coding Harnesses the agent form shows `Network access` instead of `Extra egress origins`, which they refuse.

### Development and CI/CD

- (ci) [Align files according to platform standards](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3277) by [@giantswarm-align-files[bot]](https://github.com/giantswarm-align-files[bot]) — Updates the generated CircleCI workflow from the shared templates in giantswarm/github.
- (deps) [Update dependency basic-ftp to v6.2.3](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3269) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- (deps) [Update dependency zod to v4.6.6 [security]](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3276) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- (deps) [Update dependency @types/lodash to v4.17.26](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3275) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- (deps) [Update dependency express to v5.3.0](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3270) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- (deps) [Update dependency isomorphic-git to v1.43.3](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3278) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
